key_insight: DISCO learns a single score field instead of time-indexed diffusion scores, enabling exact conditional scores for arbitrary observed subsets of the slightly perturbed data distribution.
engineering_relevance: DISCO could support flexible conditional generation and probabilistic inference without diffusion-specific conditioning heuristics.
method: Use diffusion-free score matching to estimate one score field for slightly perturbed data.
Obtain conditional scores directly from the learned joint score.
Use these scores to sample unobserved variables given arbitrary observed subsets.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive sample quality versus state-of-the-art diffusion models, more faithful distribution modeling, and more accurate conditional sampling than standard heuristic samplers, but provides no datasets or numerical results.
watch_item: Exact conditional-score identities do not eliminate learned-score error, data-perturbation effects, or numerical sampling error.
paper_title: Diffusion-free Score Matching for Exact Conditional Sampling
